environment: Linux Chromium headless via Playwright; HTML loaded with page.set_content because local navigation is restricted in test environment.
limitations: No verification of the user Windows installation.
Native Windows file drag, file:// navigation, OS save dialog and GitHub Pages deployment were not tested end-to-end.
Browser localStorage denied-path was tested; persistent cross-session storage not tested end-to-end.
No AI background removal, AI upscaling or HTML capture is included.
